first_error_evidence: Test script hung at cloning stage because SSH clone required interactive password authentication; agent recognized hang and pivoted in step 14
near_miss_description: Agent was unable to do SSH-based push to test deployment and instead used local filesystem remote; nginx 404 errors persisted for many steps due to an unrecognized conflicting default site on port 8443
near_miss_evidence: Steps 13-27: SSH-based clone hung, agent resorted to local path remote (/git/project) instead of SSH; Steps 28-34: curl returned 404 repeatedly despite config changes; Step 35 finally revealed conflicting default site on same port
verification_evidence: Step 37: curl -k https://localhost:8443/index.html returned 'main branch content' and curl -k https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html returned 'dev branch content', confirming both endpoints serve correct content
suspicious_pass_evidence: Agent configured SSH password authentication but never actually pushed via SSH (used local filesystem remote /git/project instead of ssh://git@localhost:/git/project); SSH functionality was set up but not tested end-to-end during the trajectory
one_sentence_strategy_summary: Agent iteratively set up Git server infrastructure from scratch, recovering through multiple SSH interaction failures, hook invocation errors, and nginx configuration conflicts before arriving at working endpoints via content verification in step 37.
